responsibility: Implements command-line scanning for preprocessing-related driver options. It walks argument vectors between `-fcpp-begin` and `-fcpp-end`, remembers cpp flags and selected following arguments such as `-I`, `-D`, `-isystem`, and `-imultiarch` via `M2Options.CppRemember`, and returns the updated argument index so the gm2 driver can reconstruct an accurate cpp command line without treating the source filename as a cpp option.
same_name_distinction: This implementation module performs the real preprocessing-option scan for `ScanCppArgs`, iterating over driver arguments, skipping the source filename, and forwarding remembered cpp options to `M2Options.CppRemember`. The companion `M2DriverOptions.def` only provides the exported signature.
